title: Asian Games: PH's Rosegie Ramos finishes fourth in weightlifting

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Rosegie Ramos missed the podium in the Asian Games 2026 women’s 53-kilogram weightlifting event on Wednesday at Nagoya Trade and Industry Center. Ramos, the first from the Philippines to compete in weightlifting in Aichi-Nagoya, settled for fourth place after lifting a total of 203kg. Ramos lifted 93kg in the snatch and registered 110kg in the clean and jerk, where she attempted to lift 113kg but failed. North Korea’s Kang Hyon-gyong set a new Asian Games record of a 223kg total.
